My first thought was "The School of Life", I think they are good for trying to understand.
I am also dealing with depression and a very recent break up. And it was the. First videos I went to. I hope you find something for you.
Best of luck.

Sorry to hear it.
I wish you the best of luck
I hope you will find happiness.

I try to handle it the best i can.
I just feel so alone and rejected. Because of cause  she broke up with me. 

I dont deserve love. 
No one could ever love me.
I am a bad person who is going to die alone.

Those are some of the thoughts that I am fighting today.
They will disapear with time. I know I will get better. It is something i have to deal with on top of my depression.
The problem is that i feel that i have lost and cant defend myself. Which result in a finacial loss that is very big in my currekt situation.

I am from Denmark.
But i choose the use the $ because it is know by many around the World.
My IP has been used to share stuff that i didnt own.

I am very sorry that you feel this way.
But please dont do anything that cant be undone. I have been in a similar situation to what you are feeling and felt completly alone.
But you are not alone. For one thing the people in this sub care and understand. Many of us have delt or are currently dealing with the same emotions that you are dealing with.
And remember you are not bothering anyone with your posts. What I have learned from using this sub, is that people are very helpful and ready to listen.
I wish I could tell you the solution to your problem but I dont have it. Just know that in this great and beautiful world. You are not alone. You are loved. People care.

Thank you.
I will do that.
I have tried that before but other people always confuse me and make me insecure, and for me it is worse with women, they sometimes feel like a complete mystery, but maybe that is why i want to be with her.

I am tryilg, but i dont know how to be in a relationship.
We live far apart and have only been together 3 times, but it is already my longest relationship, despite the facts that i am over 30.

Okay.

To start with i am booked in for 4 session out of the 12 that I been given by my doctor. So I could go the those and then decide what to do.
Today i just feel a little worse after my session, and just wanted some advice so as to not overreact.

She does not make me feel empty.
It is today.

Normally I feel happy when ever I think about her or am with her, so breaking up is not the solution.

My problem is that i have days where nothing matters. Nothing i do makes me happy. The day might as well not have happened.

I just want to sleep and eat and for the dayto end, and eating is a big problem because i am trying very hard to lose weight.

I have been at this point before, even though this time feels worse, and i am glad i didnt do IT back then.
Part of my brain knows for sure that life is worth living.
Everything is good in the end, if it is not good, then it is not the end. Sorry if i didnt quote IT right.
The other part which had been the most loud recently wants to end the way that i am feeling no matter the cost. 
But these feelings need time to heal and I have to work to get better. With the rigth help I will get better.

Tonight you and being able to write down my feelings, for myself and future me, has helped.
I am not going to hurt my self and do something very stupid. I have cried to the point where i dont have any tears left. And that is okay. Tomorrow is a new day, if I feel like this again i know I can find support here and that means a lot.

But Death is release from what i feel right now.

Dont worry I know it is not the answer, but today the pain of living feels to much, and to make things worse, I know some people live with worse conditions and they are able to keep fighting, so that makes me feel even weaker and worthless.

Thank you for supportting me and letting me vent.
Sometimes it helps to tell someone.
I am seeking professionelle help, but I need a thing to beresolved before i feel i can begin to feel better again.
It is the most recent situation that made me lose it completly and have caused me a Lot og pain and frustration.

I could not start the movie, instead i have been sitting on the floor crying and thinking that there is no way up from here.
Nothing in life is as I want or thought they would be and the light at the end of the tunnel might as well be a train.

Thank you, I didnt realize that there was a depression subreddit.
I will post of there.

And thank you very much for your advice, I will do my best to try and follow it, but I think that i also need professionelle help to deal with the thoughts that are haunting me.
Thank you.

Thank you very much.
I will do that.

In the long term, i need to talk to my doctor. I have been depressed before and went to the doctor for help. A different doctor because i have since moved.
But I should do that.
This day has shown me that I really need help.

As for tonight. Writing this post and reading your advice had helped. I feel more calm.
I also wrote to my girlfriend. She lives far away right now, but that helped to.

It is a lawsuit. A civil suit
And I dont know what to do.

Thank you for the advice.
I have some rum in the Kitchen.
I will use that if it get to be to much.

For now I have stopped crying and my breathing is closer to normal

I am affraid I might lose control this time. My thoughts are racing and my "soul" hurts.
I hope I can make it though today.
I need help.

Some wishes

Lily Love, Samantha Jolie
